El curador recorre el grafo una vez al d: The curator goes over the graph once a day and turns what it finds into proposals in quarantine, with their evidence. It changes nothing on its own: a curator decides each proposal, one at a time, and it can be undone. It looks for clear contradictions in the functional relations, repeated facts between the same entities, facts past their shelf life and noise; each pass is turned on separately. If the reference queries' coverage falls after its proposals are approved, it stops and says so.
